title: Chapter 130
text:
From the missions that Han Xiao had issued, Maple Moon had guessed that Han Xiao and the Germinal Organization were enemies. If it were a normal player, they would not have bothered to read the background of the mission and would have just finished it. However, she liked to enjoy the story of the game and was very curious about the story behind it. The name Black Phantom made her imagine all kinds of assassins and revenge stories. Maple Moon's sharp senses told her that there was something worth digging deeper into.

This is the first player who has interacted with me outside of missions and trades. Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Han Technician had thought about the relationship between the players and himself before coming to the conclusion that they were not enemies (except for the players who had accepted the mission to deal with him). He could extract benefits from the players and train players with potential to become his helpers. Through mutual benefits and binding benefits, he could make the players fight for him willingly.

The fact that the players could revive seemed to be disadvantageous to Han Xiao, but from another perspective, it also meant that they were the best fighters and cannon fodder for the players. Although there were many players with no moral integrity, which was also a symbol of chaos, Han Xiao knew the players' psychology very well. He understood the players' motives. As long as he grasped this context, he could control the actions of the players to a certain extent. If he used it well, he could gain a huge advantage when facing the NPC forces, just like the advantage he had when facing the players!

There seemed to be a name for this, two-timing?

Oh, no, it should be called grasping both hands and being hard on both!

Han Xiao glanced at her, then suddenly turned around and walked into the carriage. Maple Moon was stunned for a moment before following him.

The carriage was full of lathes and parts. Han Xiao pointed casually and signaled Maple Moon to sit as she pleased. He lit a cigarette and started smoking slowly. The smoke created a sense of mystery. Maple Moon saw this and knew that something was going to happen. Her heart was beating rapidly, and her face was full of anticipation.

Han Xiao flicked the ash from his cigarette and said, "The Germinal Organization is an evil organization. They use the grief of their country's destruction to manipulate the people of their country to fight for their ambitions. They want to ignite the flames of war and add another scar to this world that is already full of scars …"

Han Xiao told her about the evil and bloody deeds of the Germinal Organization, but he did not make it up. The Germinal Organization had indeed done a lot of bloody things. He could look up the files on the Dark Net and his memories from his previous life and tell her everything.

Maple Moon's emotions fluctuated as she listened to Han Xiao's narration. Her impression of the Germinal Organization had hit rock bottom, and she was filled with anger. Maple Moon was an emotional player who paid attention to the story of the game. She made decisions based on her own heart and was not completely motivated by profit.

There were many players like Maple Moon. After all, most players were here to enjoy the game. The game was also a story that could immerse people in it. However, most of these players were playing single-player games. Very few of them were playing MMOs.

Han Xiao actually admired players like Maple Moon. He coughed and purposely asked a question that was obviously a trigger, "Are you willing to become enemies with the Germinal Organization?"

This was similar to the meaning of YES/NO.

Maple Moon nodded solemnly.

"Black Phantom's favorability towards you has increased by 5 points."

After adjusting the favorability, Han Xiao took out a phone and passed it to Maple Moon. "Very good, I see your courage. When you grow up, use this phone to contact me."

"You have received the mission [Black Phantom's Invitation]: Reach level 20 and contact Black Phantom."

Maple Moon was pleasantly surprised. She was secretly excited that she had made the right choice. She was right, there was a hidden storyline that could be triggered!

Seeing the excitement on Maple Moon's face, Han Xiao smiled in his heart. He was ready to cast a wide net to catch the big fish. Due to the limit, the number of players he could train was limited. Therefore, it was very important to choose the right person. Maple Moon was going to be a famous Mechanic player in the future, and she could complement him. She was undoubtedly a very good spare tire … er, backup.

As for the specific candidates, he still had to think about it carefully. Han Xiao planned to choose those players with integrity and strength. As long as he showed that there was a hidden storyline that could be triggered, the other professional players would automatically come to him. This would give him more options.

A vague outline of a plan appeared. Han Xiao felt that it was very promising, but at the moment, he still needed to wait for the players to grow for a while before he could proceed with the next step of the plan.

…

After sending away the excited Maple Moon, Han Xiao waited until noon. Seeing that it was about time, he set a new mission and waited for the players to trigger it.

[Hunting Germinal]: Follow Black Phantom to stop a Germinal troop. This mission is a prize-pool mission. The base reward is 35,000 EXP. 500 EXP is required to accept the mission. The EXP will be distributed to the top five players (or teams) based on the ratio.

Han Xiao could give out all kinds of missions, including prize-pool missions. Unfortunately, the reward was based on the maximum limit of a single mission. However, for players who were currently around level four or five, 35,000 EXP was still an astronomical figure.

Players had to pay an 'entry fee' to accept the prize-pool mission. Han Xiao tried and realized that he could not use the EXP that players put into the prize-pool. He felt a little helpless and felt that he had lost a way to earn money.

The first to discover the prize-pool mission was from the Kill-all guild, and they were shocked by the reward.

"This is the first prize-pool mission to appear!"

"Damn, 35,000 EXP! Even the base reward is a little too much. I can only do a few hundred EXP per mission! "

"If more players accept this mission, the prize-pool will accumulate to an astronomical figure!"

The entire Kill-all guild was excited.

SliceYouUp's eyes flashed. "No, we can't let other players accept this mission!"

The guild members were shocked and looked at the guild leader in confusion. "Why?"

"Only five players or teams can get the reward for this mission. There are tens of thousands of players in Big Horn Village, and some of them are professional players. Instead of trying our luck and competing with them, why don't we just get the 35,000 EXP?" SliceYouUp said. "If only our own people accept the mission, then we can manipulate the ranking. Since the team is also considered as a whole, the EXP will be divided equally among the members. This way, the EXP won't be much. If only one person gets the ranking, then we can earn a lot!"

SliceYouUp's idea was to let a few core members, including himself, complete the mission and obtain a huge amount of EXP. They would be trained as elites, which was equivalent to transferring the EXP of other members to the elites. Each member would only get 500 EXP. It was not much, but if all the EXP was gathered on one person, it would greatly increase the growth of that person.

The members looked at each other. Although they were a little reluctant, compared to work, it was just a little EXP. They did not care if it was gone, so they all agreed.

"The mission will start in the afternoon, so Black Phantom will definitely leave early. So, we just need to prevent any players from coming into contact with Black Phantom for two hours, and we'll be done!"

SliceYouUp ordered the members to guard Han Xiao with their pistols. "If anyone comes near, warn them. If they don't listen, just shoot."

The Kill-all guild had more than 20 core members and more than 100 peripheral members in Big Horn Village. It was the biggest force at the moment.

These workshop-like guilds were different from casual players. They had businesses in many games. Only when they determined that a game was worth investing in would they mobilize members from other games to join. The Kill-all guild had thousands of members, but there were only slightly more than 100 players in Galaxy at the moment. They would only continue to join when more game capsules were released.

Players could kill each other. The more they killed, the more evil they would accumulate. Once they were killed by others, they would drop more EXP and equipment.

…

Han Xiao realized that there was a circle of guild players around him. They were threatening and chasing away other players, not allowing anyone to come into contact with him. They were very strong in numbers, and the players who were chased away did not dare to say anything.

After thinking for a while, he understood the Kill-all guild's intention. His face darkened. "How dare you try to monopolize my prize-pool mission?"

The original intention of releasing the prize-pool mission was to mobilize more players to be cannon fodder. The Kill-all guild's actions had interfered with his plan.

A large group of players surrounded him, filled with righteous indignation.

"Too overbearing! I just want to restock my ammo! "

"What right do you have to monopolize Black Phantom?"

At this time, the people from Sky Territory squeezed through the crowd and confronted the Kill-all guild.

Jade Green Sky shouted, "What do you want from Kill-all?"

SliceYouUp was expressionless and did not explain at all. He waved his hand, and the guild members around him immediately raised their pistols and aimed. It caused a chain reaction, and Sky Territory also raised their pistols.

The players were in an uproar and hurriedly backed away to avoid being splashed with blood.

Jade Green Sky was a little hesitant. He had fewer people on his side compared to Kill-all. Once the battle started, he would definitely be at a disadvantage. He did not understand why the Kill-all guild suddenly became so overbearing. There must be something fishy, but with so many people watching, Sky Territory could not back down.

Jade Green Sky and his guild members looked at each other and confirmed each other's thoughts.

Fight!

Both sides were ready to fight.

The players craned their necks to watch the show. It was not every day that two guilds fought, and these were two big famous guilds.

The battle was about to start.

At this time, everyone in Kill-all received a notification on the interface.

"Black Phantom's favorability towards you decreased by ten points. Current favorability is -five points. Current relationship: Cold!"
